item.title: Dispersion of the Subject: An Ethico-Pathological Analysis of the Society of Control and Its Technological Protocols
item.description: Looking at the dim, dark gray room before you, nearly devoid of anything, you can only sink into deep despair. This is a shadow forgotten by civilization. The darkness here has substance — it clings to your skin like thick ink. Wrapped in the musty darkness, rust stains, and heavy walls, as long as you still have senses, you’ll realize you are a prisoner. The barred window is the only place where light enters — a small, square grate high above, teasing you. You’d better not dream of escaping through it. The occasional passing guard won’t regard you as human — he is the embodiment of violence. Fortunately, he himself isn’t too keen on frequenting your shabby, miserable little space.
